I need to consider that there might be no Redis available, so I'll have to inspect the store or cache and the configuration settings. It’s important to ensure everything is set up correctly. Correcting the premise is the first step. I want to get this right so I can move forward with the task effectively. If Redis isn't an option, I'll need to think about alternatives too. Let’s see what I find!

r01.
Premise correction: no Redis connection is configured; the cache is in-process memory (`store/cache/cache.go:66-92`). Actual mechanism: user entries use the default 10-minute TTL, configured in `store.New` (`store/store.go:37-53`) and applied by `userCache` (`store/user.go:148-168`).
